description: This file defines a controller class 'EmployeeReportToController' in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for handling the 'report to' information of employees, including preparing data for rendering views and managing permissions within the HRM application.

classes.name: EmployeeReportToController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing 'report to' relationships for employees, including pre-rendering setup and permission management.

methods.name: getReportingMethodConfigurationService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the ReportingMethodConfigurationService instance used to fetch reporting methods.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and components for rendering the 'report to' employee view, setting permissions and handling missing employee number.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data groups relevant for capability permission checks; specifies supervisor and subordinates.
